name: Backport to 29.x
run-name: Backport PR ${{ inputs.source_pr }} to 29.x (dry run = ${{ inputs.dry_run }})
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_pr:
        description: Merged source PR number in this test fork
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: Preview without creating or changing repository objects
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean
permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: backport-demo-${{ github.repository_id }}-${{ inputs.source_pr }}-29
  cancel-in-progress: false
  INPUT_SOURCE_PR: ${{ inputs.source_pr }}
  INPUT_DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run && 'true' || 'false' }}
  ALLOWED_ACTOR_IDS: ${{ vars.BACKPORT_ALLOWED_ACTOR_IDS || '59250993' }}
  validate:
    if: github.repository == 'AleksanderGladkov/BCApps-Backport-Test' && github.repository_id == '1369849596' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
  track:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: write
  prepare:
    needs: track
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
  publish:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts/backport-demo
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: backport-plan-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: backport-plan-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: backport-tracking-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: backport-tracking-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
      - name: Save clean result or Milica's conflict handoff
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: backport-result-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: backport-result-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
      - name: Preserve publication and recovery evidence, including failures
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: backport-publication-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/backport-state
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

protected_paths.scope: Source, installed, legacy and previously recorded reference copies; private path manifest is not distributed.

capture.scope: Historical baseline receipt, not the result of the current exporter invocation or PowerShell acceptance.

correspondence.decision: Exact source, target and actor revalidation; dispatch authorization is not interactive aggregate approval.
Independent temporary repositories protect callers; persistent worktree recovery is not supported.
Verified squash cherry-pick and independent reconstruction; legitimate smaller deltas require exact final content.
Reconcile exact bot-owned objects; journals, fresh history and create-only branch leases prohibit blind recreation.
Keep the executor conflict handoff and stop publication; no resolver invocation or schema adapter.
Read back branches and PRs; preparation published=false is not a final receipt. A separate receipt is deferred.
Independent public-safe synthetic fixtures supplement, not replace, the 67 baseline cases.
One source and one target; no reviewer policy, branch-only mode, bulk coordination or translation.

helper_dispositions.decision: Raw byte streams and argument lists inform independent fork-local bounded transport.
Sorted keys and atomic writes retained; Python escaping, types and exact bytes remain authoritative.
Recompute content before publication; legitimate subset deltas differ from exact changed-path manifests.
Verify branch/base/head with fixed-scope HTTP and create-only publication; no work-item or CLI transport.
Keep existing remote verification and journal evidence; introduce no new result schema.

TEST-021.observed: Partial fix publishes only the missing effect; complete fix is a no-op; rehashed missing/extra effects are rejected.

TEST-022.scope: Dirty caller and unrelated working-directory isolation

TEST-023.scope: Exact fork conflict handoff; no skill import or resolver

TEST-024.scope: Fresh remote read-back and retained publication journals

verification.scope: Reference data and baseline observations only, not PowerShell acceptance.

capture.interpretation: Historical live Python handoffs. Final tests run PowerShell, compare against these immutable references, then seed verified baseline artifact bytes. Replay is not current bidirectional Python execution.
capture.path_policy: Only fixture-owned environment roots are represented by <fixture-root>; local Git effects retain the existing <fixture-origin> marker. Validate actual root containment and link-free ancestors. Never normalize artifact bytes.
capture.procedure: Use the hash-pinned historical TestHelpers stage/state handoffs and exporter load_baseline; run only login, two-file, rehashed-effect, full-stage/reuse/binding, reason/effect, credential and same-binding cases. Baseline unittest suite is not executed. Each record binds the complete environment (synthetic credential omitted), stages, capture-failure mode, optional typed user response, source/target/commit refs, prior artifact bytes, API state, output/summary and Git effects. Record unchanged oracle response and post-state. Sort reference-envelope keys ordinally and encode compressed UTF-8 JSON; artifacts remain exact hex bytes. Compare repeated input keys for exact output agreement.
